tools.title: Color Palette Extractor
tools.description: A powerful tool for extracting color palettes from images with accessibility analysis and WCAG compliance checking.

tools.title: Color Swapper
tools.description: A powerful web-based tool for swapping and modifying colors in images. This tool allows you to select colors from an image and swap them with new colors, as well as apply hardware-style color palettes to your images.

tools.title: Favicon Creator
tools.description: A powerful, easy-to-use tool for generating production-ready favicon bundles from any image. This tool creates all necessary favicon formats including 16x16, 32x32, 180x180, 192x192, and 512x512 pixel icons, along with a Web App Manifest file for modern web applications.

tools.title: Gif Viewer
tools.description: Complete fixed standalone version.

tools.title: Image Crop And Scale
tools.description: A powerful image cropping and scaling tool designed for game developers and digital artists. Automatically calculates platform-specific dimensions and provides precise control over image processing for multiple platforms and custom requirements.

tools.title: Image Split And Combine
tools.description: This tool allows you to split images into smaller pieces and combine them back together. It's useful for creating image puzzles, tile-based graphics, or preparing images for specific applications.

tools.title: Image To Svg Converter
tools.description: A powerful, client-side tool for converting raster images to scalable vector graphics (SVG) directly in your browser. This tool uses the ImageTracer.js library to transform pixel-based images into clean, editable SVG vector graphics without any server processing.

tools.title: Image Transparency Tool
tools.description: A simple and intuitive web-based tool for adjusting image transparency and downloading transparent PNG files.

tools.title: Normalmap Maker
tools.description: Browser-based tool for creating tangent-space normal maps from image textures, sprites, height maps, alpha masks, or batches of source images.

tools.title: Pixel Art Converter
tools.description: A web-based tool for converting images into pixel art with customizable settings and high-quality output.

tools.title: Seamless Texture Maker
tools.description: Create professional, tiling seamless textures for 3D models, web designs, and more with this powerful online tool.

tools.title: Spritesheet Utility
tools.description: SpriteForge AI is a local-first spritesheet utility for quick grid slicing and AI-assisted sprite detection.

tools.title: Svg Editor
tools.description: A powerful browser-based SVG editor for creating and modifying vector graphics.

tools.title: Texture Map Painter
tools.description: Paint and preview a compact material texture set containing albedo, height, tangent-space normal, roughness, and smoothness maps.

tools.title: Toon Image Shader
tools.description: A browser-based image processing tool that converts photos and images into cel-shaded, comic-style toon art with customizable parameters. Uses HTML5 Canvas API for local, real-time processing — no server uploads required.

tools.title: Beat Maker

tools.title: Music Visualizer

tools.title: Sfx Generator
tools.description: A powerful Web Audio API-based sound effects generator that allows you to create custom audio samples with various waveforms, parameters, and presets.

tools.title: Csharp Class Extractor

tools.title: Css Background Generator

tools.title: Css To Scss

tools.title: Dialogue Tree Visualizer

tools.title: Electron App Icon Generator

tools.title: Gamejuice Generator
tools.description: An interactive HTML5 dashboard for prototyping and previewing game "juice" — the visual and audio feedback effects that make games feel satisfying. Generate particles, screenshake, easing animations, sound timing, sprite animations, and export ready-to-use code snippets for popular game engines.
